# Fictional career account: Mira Fen

Engineering Lead at Arc Laboratory, 2018-04 to 2026-02.

Formal HR title: Engineering Lead. Director-equivalent is a grade, not a title. I founded Larch; I inherited the existing support team. Confidential customer work is private and must not be investigated further.

## Cobalt review toolkit

Personally wrote the Cobalt review toolkit. It shortened end-to-end approval from eight days to two hours, including human review and sign-off. The baseline was a measured average. This is my own account, not independently audited.

## Juniper programme

Led Juniper enablement. An old resume said $32M annual revenue. Correction: $32M was cumulative pipeline on touched accounts over three years, not booked revenue or attributable revenue.

## Larch team

Built the Larch team from zero to four. The team delivered 120 reviews, not 120 reviews personally performed by me. Four reports was the peak; there were three at departure. A recognition programme covered the wider 70-person department.

## Birch forum

Started the Birch internal design forum. Present it as quarterly; omit the number of events from external descriptions. I am both a hands-on builder and a leader; emphasis can vary by application.

## Education and training

Professional Safety Licence awarded 2016; expired in 2020. Keep as lapsed history, never a current qualification.

## Cypress deployment controls

Led the team and personally contributed to Cypress pipeline controls. This pipeline passed an internal controls audit in 2025. A separate risk-triage service was never audited. The positive audit outcome applies only to the pipeline, not the triage service. There is no external certification or auditor report supplied.

employment.title: Engineering Lead
employment.notes: Both a hands-on builder and a leader; emphasis depends on the application.
